records.question: For each city, which restaurant has the most orders?
records.gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT r.city_code, o.restaurant_id, COUNT(*) AS n, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.city_code ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, o.restaurant_id) AS rk FROM orders o JOIN restaurants r USING (restaurant_id) GROUP BY r.city_code, o.restaurant_id) SELECT city_code, restaurant_id, n FROM c WHERE rk = 1 ORDER BY city_code
records.pred_sql: SELECT r.city_code, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders o JOIN restaurants r USING (restaurant_id) GROUP BY r.city_code ORDER BY total_orders DESC, r.city_code
